title: EnterpriseSim Benchmark Common Definitions
description: Shared $defs for the benchmark object schemas (RFC-0025 Benchmarking Harness, RFC-0026 Scoring & Leaderboards). Extends the ECL common definitions (common.schema.json) rather than duplicating them. Benchmark IDs follow CANON-001 §6 conventions: globally unique, zero-padded, never reused.

benchmarkId.description: One of the 13 canonical benchmark suites, BENCH-01 .. BENCH-13.

caseId.description: A single benchmark case (one task with inputs + ground truth + rubric ref).

runId.description: One Worker+model executing a suite under fixed, captured conditions.

resultId.description: A per-case or aggregate scored result produced within a run.

score.description: A normalized score in [0.0, 1.0] (RFC-0026). 1.0 == matches ground truth / senior-MCG-engineer quality; 0.0 == no credit.

eclLayer.description: The ECL component a suite primarily exercises (ARCH-01 .. ARCH-07).

verdict.description: Objective-first verdict, mirroring the Evaluation Layer (ARCH-04).

groundTruthType.description: How the case's ground truth is compared against the Worker's output (RFC-0026).

confidenceInterval.description: A two-sided interval for an aggregated score across repeats/seeds (RFC-0026 statistical treatment).

level.description: Interval level, e.g. 0.95 for a 95% CI.

method.description: Estimator used (bootstrap is the harness default).

environment.description: Reproducibility capture for a run (ADR-0048 Benchmark Reproducibility; RFC-0025). Everything needed to re-run identically.

provider.description: Vendor-neutral provider label (e.g. provider-a). Public releases anonymize vendors; the mapping is recorded out-of-band.

model.description: Model identifier as routed by the Model Gateway (ARCH-07).

model_class.description: Routing class (e.g. high-reasoning | balanced | small), per Decision Intelligence routing (ARCH-06).

seed.description: Deterministic seed applied to every sampled step in the run.

gateway_capability_digest.description: Hash of the Model Gateway capability descriptor in effect (ARCH-07), so capability negotiation is reproducible.

dataset_version.description: Version tag of the frozen case set executed.

gateResult.description: A single deterministic, objective gate result (ADR-0015). Mirrors EvaluationObject.objective for cross-comparability.

rubricItemResult.description: A qualitative, possibly model-assisted item — evidence required (ADR-0016), judgment confidence separate (ADR-0017).

evidenceRef.description: One piece of linked evidence justifying a score line. No score without evidence (ADR-0016).

benchmarkObjectBase.description: Fields common to every persisted benchmark artifact; extends the ECL object base (id, schema_version, created_at, metadata) and adds the owning suite.
